Population.evidence_source: Among the surveyed men, there was a lack of interaction between them and their family members. The lack of dialogue and opportunities to exchange ideas associated with the abuse of alcohol and drugs in the family environment weakened the family relations and led to conflict and arguments, which widened the gap between the men and their families and triggered the suicide attempt.
